system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; no prompt construction described.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: It then searches the target framework and reference repositories for adapters, registries, operator dispatch tables, kernel bindings, fall- back rules, build flags, and tests.
env_context_strategy.note: The graph builder also parses repository artifacts into a graph, which may count as injected context. This could arguably be coded mixed.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config or history processor is available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: ei is evidence from logs, exceptions,
observation_format.note: Inferred from the paper's prose about logs and profiles.

edit_primitive.note: Patches are described, but the edit primitive is not.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Failing validation updates status and cost, then the search tree can roll back to the nearest stable graph snapshot.
loop_primitives.note: Three loops: build the graph, restore routes (patch/validate), then reduce cost.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the graph is not a retrospective drawing, but the control state that determines the next search, patch, and validation step.
planning_granularity.note: The execution-adaptation graph acts as a structured plan/state. The paper also mentions a resource-aware staged planner.

multi_agent_topology.note: Table 1 lists separate migration, profiling and kernel agents. The topology is inferred and could also be a pipeline.

human_in_loop.note: The paper says external SLOs and tolerances are treated as external constraints.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the graph is part of the agent’s working memory and control state

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: A successful adaptation episode produces a transferable knowledge package:
long_term_memory.note: The cross-episode knowledge package is used to initialise the target graph. This is the closest allowed value.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the validation framework builds, loads, compares, and serves.
self_verification.note: Staged validation uses golden cases and profiling.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Code search, log attribution, local build repair, and single- device golden cases can receive several automatic attempts
retry_policy.note: Attempts are budgeted per stage. This could arguably be coded adaptive.

rollback.evidence_quote: the search tree can roll back to the nearest stable graph snapshot.
rollback.note: The paper describes graph snapshots; the rollback mechanism for code is unclear.

termination_condition.note: The paper mentions resource budget Bi, but no stop mechanism is described.

cost_controls.note: The search cost covers tokens and is used by the planner; no enforced cap is described.

eval_hooks.note: The paper says a benchmark is future work; no repository is available.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Patches may modify adapters, runtime dispatch, ker- nels, and configuration, but must not modify checkpoint weights, model structure, or mathematical semantics
guardrails.note: These invariants are stated in the paper; how they are enforced is not described.

target_domain.evidence_quote: We present MetaInfer, an LLM-agent system that formulates inference adaptation as route search over a costed execution-adaptation graph.
target_domain.note: The domain is inference-framework adaptation, a specialised software-engineering task.

open_source.note: No repo_url is given. The dsv4-on-ampere link in the paper is a reference implementation, not MetaInfer.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: We present MetaInfer, an LLM-agent system

first_release_date.note: The v1 date is not in the evidence; v3 is dated 1 Sep 2026.

pinned_version.note: Paper version only; no code is available.
